description: Steve's Army is a mod that add comprehesive firearm using AI

releases.notes:
### Animation
- Fixed the unarmed crouching pose and transitions.
- Fixed soldier size and arm texture clipping.

### Compatibility
- Added optional **Curios API** support, allowing soldiers to wear compatible accessories.
- Fixed a startup crash on Forge 47.3.

### Combat
- Fixed ATTACK orders stalling after soldiers recover from being pinned.
- Fixed prone soldiers failing to fire at a visible head above cover.
- Added a **Hold Fire** discipline.

### Support
- Fixed support soldiers' resupply and revival duties, including targeted supplies being intercepted.
- Support soldiers can attempt to use smoke when rescuing a downed player and retry as they approach.

### Configuration
- Added separate death-drop options for friendly and enemy soldiers.
- Added a limit on guns and matching ammo dropped loose when a soldier dies.

### Friend-or-Foe Identification
- Reworked friend-or-foe relations with shared diplomacy and updated squad controls.

### Soldier Swap
- Swapping bodies carries health with it: take the soldier's current health and leave your own behind. Swapping back no longer provides a free heal.

### Machine Gunner Overhaul
- Machine gunners retain their existing support-role cover and movement safeguards while providing sustained ATTACK suppression.
- Suppression bursts rotate across every known enemy position, with multiple gunners interleaving their fire instead of stacking on one target.
- Visible targets receive longer bursts with faster recovery and better tracking on moving enemies, while low-in-cover firing keeps the gun's crawl recoil.
- Cover seeking now completes the move more reliably instead of stranding a gunner mid-seek or skipping from cover straight to the objective.

### Danger Map & Moving Under Fire
- Squads build a line-of-sight danger map from known threats. Friendly and enemy pathfinding favors safer routes around kill zones, while danger remains a cost rather than an impassable wall.
- Suppressed soldiers keep moving when a safer route exists, and crawl through stretches where going low reduces exposure while incoming fire is fresh.
- Relocation under suppression only happens when the route is fully safe; fully pinned soldiers hold their cover instead of walking out.

### Prone Positions & Squad Spacing
- Soldiers prioritize physical cover that protects them from the threat. When suitable cover is unavailable, they can spread into prone firing positions with usable sightlines.
- Squad spacing applies while moving and selecting defensive positions, including prone firing lanes. The spacing distance is configurable, with a default of 3 blocks.

### CQB & Room Clearing
- Close-quarters behavior no longer freezes when an enemy is spotted nearby, and close-range cover seeking works more consistently.
- Squads queue at doorways, pre-aim around corners and search last-known enemy positions after contact breaks.
- Soldiers make smaller corner peeks and can briefly expose themselves to fire a short burst at a recently spotted enemy before withdrawing.
- ATTACK combines an assault with room-by-room and area clearing, advancing cover-to-cover and checking blind spots before reporting "Area secured. All clear."
- Improved clearing objectives and regrouping on slabs and other partial-height ground. New orders take over from earlier regrouping tasks.

### Movement & Recovery
- Traverse lets soldiers relocate quickly while Tactical movement runs at 40% pace so they can fight while advancing.
- Fire teams cross open ground in bounds with an overwatching gunner; soldiers caught in the open return fire instead of endlessly re-seeking cover.
- Normal travel speed is capped around player sprint speed, with fixes for movement bursts and sudden skips.
- GO_TO orders arrive properly and hand off to cover, with improved long-distance travel and obstacle detours.
- Fixed soldiers becoming stranded outside cover during reloads, suppression or interrupted movement, and fixed doorway detection on raised paths.
- Added recovery from persistent movement failures. Soldiers trapped in enclosed terrain can relocate a short distance as a last resort while retaining their movement order.

### Soldier Animation Overhaul
- Rebuilt soldier presentation around a Simple Enemy-derived full-body rig and animation set, with updated idle, hit reactions, death animations and head tracking.
- Improved TaCZ weapon handling and ready stances for rifles, pistols and miniguns, alongside updated armor and stowed-weapon rendering.
- Added refreshed standing, crouching, kneeling, cover and crawl transitions. Half-cover firing uses a planted one-knee stance, with an updated walking and running stride.

### Command Wheels & Fireteam HUD
- Added optional click-to-open controls for command, vehicle, formation and fire-team wheels. Hold-to-open remains the default.

...

## Vehicle Crew
- **New role: Vehicle Crew** — post soldiers on ships to man hull machine guns and periscopes (uses tallyho stations)
- Board crew via the crew assign stick, spawn egg on a seat, or the vehicle wheel's Mount Crew order; crew ignore infantry squad orders and are managed from a dedicated crew tab in the squad command screen
- Hull MG fire control now follows the infantry doctrine: burst discipline, suppressive fire with beaten-zone spread, and live-target verification (no more firing at dead targets)
- Crew stay seated at their stations across server/world restarts
- Dying as a soldier can respawn you into a seated crew member's seat
- Crew seats work on multi-ship vehicles (tanks built from stacked sub-ships)
- Seated soldiers now sit on the cushion instead of hovering above it

## Vehicle Orders
- **New vehicle control wheel** — left-click ping wheel with cycling pages: MOUNT, DISMOUNT, and MOUNT CREW orders for your squad
- VS Analog Warfare mount handle integration: MOUNT/DISMOUNT prefer linked handles, creating them when needed

## Misc
- Pick-block now copies enemy soldiers with their loadout too
- Fixed smoke being ignored when the perception frame optimization is enabled
- Refined role selection interaction (role dropdown controls)
- Fixed enemy soldiers spawning with infinite initial ammo
- Skin system: SkinKnife for switching skins, folder-based skin loading (`stevesarmy/skins/*.png`), a config to randomize skins on spawn, and automatic server-to-client skin sync
- Dropdown in the squad command screen to change an individual soldier's fireteam
- Client toggles for soldier glow and name tags

## Cover System
- Cover positions that don't protect against the current threat are now hard-blacklisted
- Major reliability rework: fail-safe cover state machine, faster threat reaction, cover-target churn fixes
- Fixed full-cover peek stalling and returning deadlocks

## Roles
- **New Role: Support (Medic)** with resupply pouch; recognizes lrtactical healing consumables
- Command sticks for repositioning soldiers to garrison points (garrison/team garrison)
- Fixed support role peeking, resupply safety, and multi-gun ammo

## Commands
- Callsign squads and a full ComputerCraft command toolkit for scripting battles with computer-controlled squads

## Performance
- Reduced MSPT spikes: perception frame, tactical work admission, and bounded cover searches
- Multithreaded async A* pathfinding (enabled by default)
- Optimized detection ray tracing

## Fireteam Suppression System
- Fireteam suppression now governs attack/peek behavior
- If an entire fireteam is pinned, they peek less and advance more slowly while attacking
- Attacking fireteams that get suppressed deploy smoke grenades when available

## Attack Mode Refinement
- The soldier at the front waits for the soldiers at the back, and stragglers speed up to catch up with the group

## VS Compat
- Fixed visibility — soldiers can no longer see (or shoot) through ships

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/MegiTicky/steves-army/compare/v0.3.0...v0.4.0
